pilot_scope.allowed_lane_shape: disjoint-scope WOs with no same-file contention

required_steps: capture task-list state and partial lane packets
finish through sequential/subagent VibeOS build path
record fallback reason before completion claim

go_no_go_criteria.partial_unlock_target: TeammateIdle or missing-return detection recorded within 5 minutes p95 and 10 minutes max
go_no_go_criteria.no_go_condition: any unrecorded stall or max latency over 10 minutes

go_no_go_criteria.partial_unlock_target: at least one material issue caught before merge/closeout, or every scoped lane records clean pre-merge evidence with no post-closeout regression
go_no_go_criteria.no_go_condition: defect found only after closeout or missing evidence that checks ran before merge

go_no_go_criteria.partial_unlock_target: lead coordination time no more than 80 percent of the sequential baseline for the same lane count
go_no_go_criteria.no_go_condition: coordination time equals or exceeds sequential baseline, or is not measured

go_no_go_criteria.partial_unlock_target: zero unauthorized path writes and zero missing-WO task closures
go_no_go_criteria.no_go_condition: any governance veto, out-of-scope edit, or missing-WO task closure

go_no_go_criteria.partial_unlock_target: pilot cost captured and reviewed; no default adoption if cost exceeds sequential/subagent baseline by more than 25 percent
go_no_go_criteria.no_go_condition: missing cost evidence or materially higher cost without a quality win
